verdict.rationale: Gram provides usage/cost tracking (gram-gh-1) and tool-call logs (gram-docs-5), plus governance controls like blocking shadow servers (gram-docs-10), but there is no evidence of published quality signals such as health/liveness checks, verification badges, or comparative quality scores that a developer could use to compare servers side-by-side. Missing for 10: liveness/health-check indicators, explicit quality/verification badges, and any server-comparison or ranking UI.
